title: Briefing for 2026-10-17
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-17: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all. Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done. U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting. Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge. China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration.
global: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role. Pope pictured for first time since surgery and cancer diagnosis. India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest. Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow. Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?. I find it quite demoralising in store - why I do all my shopping online.
philippines: Marcos to summon China envoy over ‘threat’ | The wRap. JAZA: Does the Philippines have what it takes to win big investments?. From Duterte to Big Tech: Maria Ressa’s blueprint on fighting back. Posh Skin unveils new acne sheet mask for an instant skin refresh.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
